mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 6% for three consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand, which reduces earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when UNRATE > 6% for three months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in personal consumption expenditures (CPIAUCSL) below the 2% annualized growth rate for six months signals weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate earnings and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when CPIAUCSL YoY growth < 2% for six months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below its 12-month moving average for eight consecutive months signals weakening manufacturing activity, which reduces earnings and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO < 12-month MA for eight months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in payroll employment (PAYEMS) above 2% month-over-month for three consecutive months signals a tightening labor market, which increases wage pressure and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when PAYEMS > 2% MoM for three months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the Housing Starts Index (HOUST) below its 12-month moving average for six consecutive months signals weakening residential demand, which reduces construction-related earnings and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when HOUST < 12-month MA for six months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% for three consecutive months signals a restrictive monetary policy stance, which increases discount rates and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% for three months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) below its 12-month moving average for four consecutive months signals weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate earnings and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when RSAFS < 12-month MA for four months (t-test p > 0.05).
